scope: Original Darwin loopback stream socket ABI for an owned app-to-reader event channel inside the guest. No external or host endpoint; no policy or entitlement changes.
version_limit: The public source tag is later than the installed beta. Installed System export availability is separately checked; actual socket authorization still requires execution.

layout.sockaddr_in: 16 bytes: uint8 sin_len at0, uint8 family at1, network-byte-order uint16 port at2, IPv4 bytes at4, zero padding8. Exact loopback address bytes127,0,0,1.
layout.pollfd: 8 bytes: int32 fd at0, int16 events at4, int16 revents at6.
layout.poll: int poll(struct pollfd *, unsigned int nfds, int timeout_milliseconds);
layout.socket_lengths: socklen_t uint32; send/recv count size_t64 and return ssize_t64 on arm64.

review_requirements: Bind and connect only explicit127.0.0.1 at fixed unprivileged port, never INADDR_ANY.
Use bounded buffers/record lengths, partial read/write handling, boot/PID/sequence filtering. TCP is a stream, not a record transport.
Set SO_NOSIGPIPE for any socket that sends; check failures before sending.
Set nonblocking status with preserved F_GETFL flags; explicitly configure accepted sockets.
Complete EINPROGRESS connect using writable/error poll and getsockopt(SO_ERROR), not writable alone.
Keep monotonic deadlines bounded across EINTR and repeated EAGAIN.
Treat root/local transport as permission-checked; do not claim successful authorization before actual guest results.

candidate_review.status: No source-review staging blocker after removal of undeclared constructor assignment. Original guest permission and successful relay remain unproven until execution.
candidate_review.bounded_io: Connect checks SO_ERROR and POLLOUT. Send retains partial offset; receive retains partial line. Eight iterations with250ms polls bound requested poll waits to2seconds per phase; scheduling adds elapsed time. Accepted sockets explicitly configured nonblocking. Listener alarm7200seconds and64 accepted connections.
candidate_review.framing: Requires newline within191 bytes; embedded NUL rejected. Trailing bytes already present in the same receive are rejected. Later segments after first accepted newline are discarded on close, not separately validated. Exactly one owned record is sent per connection.
candidate_review.validation: Exact current boot UUID; decimal PID1..INT_MAX, sequence1..64 and strictly increasing per PID; fixed event-name allowlist; count0..1000000; original proc_pidpath exact owned executable and SHORTBSDINFO uid501 checks.
candidate_review.identity_limit: Claimed PID is checked but TCP peer PID is not authenticated; diagnostics explicitly state peer_pid_authenticated=0. This is bounded fixture telemetry, not an authentication protocol.
candidate_review.delivery_limit: App send success is not receiver acceptance. Only original guest serial validated relay records plus reviewed visual journey establish execution.
candidate_review.scope: No host listener/forwarding, filesystem-reader permission, container provisioning, external network endpoint, or policy change.
